about.title: Analytical by training, a communicator by practice.
paragraphs: I'm a final-year **Digital Business & Innovation** student at Tokyo International University, building toward a career in **analyst, finance, and fintech** roles. My work sits at the intersection of numbers and narrative: I use **SQL and Python** to pull structure out of messy financial data, then translate what I find into decisions people can act on.

That habit of translating complexity into something clear didn't start in a classroom — it comes from two years coaching competitive debate, where the job is to take a dense argument and make it land in three minutes. I bring the same rigor and clarity to spreadsheets and SQL queries as I do to a debate brief.
Currently based in Saitama, Japan, holding a **3.51 CGPA** in my senior year, and conversational in Japanese (JLPT N3) alongside native fluency in Bangla and English.

bullets: Tracked and managed 100–150 daily orders for an early-stage e-commerce startup, monitoring fulfillment status and flagging process bottlenecks to leadership.
Analyzed sales and order data to identify a **~15% month-over-month growth trend**, directly informing pricing and inventory decisions.
Built demand forecasts from order and growth data, helping reduce stockouts by an estimated **20%** during peak periods.
Coach and mentor a roster of **80 debaters**, designing training curricula on argumentation, rebuttal, and public speaking.
Run regular practice tournaments and structured feedback sessions to prepare debaters for competitive circuits.

projects.title: Stock Price Tracker
bullets: Built an end-to-end stock analysis pipeline in Python (pandas, matplotlib, yfinance) — data collection, cleaning, exploratory analysis, and visualization for a multi-stock portfolio.
Computed daily returns, 30-day rolling volatility, and cross-stock correlation to evaluate risk and diversification benefits.
Result: JPM delivered the best 2024 total return (42.40%), MSFT showed the lowest volatility, and low JPM–AAPL correlation supported the case for diversification.

projects.title: Bank Transaction Analyzer
bullets: Designed and queried a SQLite database of personal bank transactions to surface spending patterns, monthly trends, and top expense categories.
Wrote SQL queries — aggregate functions, GROUP BY, strftime date parsing — to rank top merchants by volume and compute average transaction size by category.
Flagged the largest single transactions to support anomaly review and budgeting decisions.
